verses.en: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.pt: No fim do sábado, quando já despontava o primeiro dia da semana, Maria Madalena e a outra Maria foram ver o sepulcro.
verses.en_web: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
verses.en_bbe: Now late on the Sabbath, when the dawn of the first day of the week was near, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the place where his body was.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
verses.pt: E eis que houvera um grande terremoto; pois um anjo do Senhor descera do céu e, chegando-se, removera a pedra e estava sentado sobre ela.
verses.en_web: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.
verses.en_bbe: And there was a great earth-shock; for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, rolling back the stone, took his seat on it.

verses.en: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.pt: o seu aspecto era como um relâmpago, e as suas vestes brancas como a neve.
verses.en_web: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
verses.en_bbe: His form was shining like the light, and his clothing was white as snow:

verses.en: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
verses.pt: E de medo dele tremeram os guardas, e ficaram como mortos.
verses.en_web: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
verses.en_bbe: And for fear of him the watchmen were shaking, and became as dead men.

verses.en: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.pt: Mas o anjo disse às mulheres: Não temais vós; pois eu sei que buscais a Jesus, que foi crucificado.
verses.en_web: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel said to the women, Have no fear: for I see that you are searching for Jesus, who was put to death on the cross.

verses.en: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.pt: Não está aqui, porque ressurgiu, como ele disse. Vinde, vede o lugar onde jazia;
verses.en_web: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
verses.en_bbe: He is not here, for he has come to life again, even as he said. Come, see the Lord's resting-place.

verses.en: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.pt: e ide depressa, e dizei aos seus discípulos que ressurgiu dos mortos; e eis que vai adiante de vós para a Galiléia; ali o vereis. Eis que vo-lo tenho dito.
verses.en_web: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
verses.en_bbe: And go quickly and give his disciples the news that he has come back from the dead, and is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him, as I have said to you.

verses.en: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.pt: E, partindo elas pressurosamente do sepulcro, com temor e grande alegria, correram a anunciá-lo aos discípulos.
verses.en_web: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
verses.en_bbe: And they went away quickly, with fear and great joy, to give his disciples the news.

verses.en: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.pt: E eis que Jesus lhes veio ao encontro, dizendo: Salve. E elas, aproximando-se, abraçaram-lhe os pés, e o adoraram.
verses.en_web: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.en_bbe: And on the way, Jesus came to them, saying, Be glad. And they came and put their hands on his feet, and gave him worship.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.pt: Então lhes disse Jesus: Não temais; ide dizer a meus irmãos que vão para a Galiléia; ali me verão.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
verses.en_bbe: Then said Jesus to them, Have no fear: go and give word to my brothers to go into Galilee, and there they will see me.

verses.en: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
verses.pt: Ora, enquanto elas iam, eis que alguns da guarda foram à cidade, e contaram aos principais sacerdotes tudo quanto havia acontecido.
verses.en_web: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
verses.en_bbe: Now, while they were going, some of the watchmen came into the town and gave news to the chief priests of all the things which had taken place.

verses.en: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.pt: E congregados eles com os anciãos e tendo consultado entre si, deram muito dinheiro aos soldados,
verses.en_web: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
verses.en_bbe: And when they had come together with those in authority, and had made their decision, they gave much money to the watchmen, saying,

verses.en: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.pt: e ordenaram-lhes que dissessem: Vieram de noite os seus discípulos e, estando nós dormindo, furtaram-no.
verses.en_web: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.en_bbe: Say, His disciples came by night and took him away secretly while we were sleeping.

verses.en: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.pt: E, se isto chegar aos ouvidos do governador, nós o persuadiremos, e vos livraremos de cuidado.
verses.en_web: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
verses.en_bbe: And if this comes to the ruler's ears, we will see that he does not make you responsible.

verses.en: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.pt: Então eles, tendo recebido o dinheiro, fizeram como foram instruídos. E essa história tem-se divulgado entre os judeus até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.
verses.en_bbe: So they took the money, and did as they had been ordered: and this account has been current among the Jews till the present time.

verses.en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.pt: Partiram, pois, os onze discípulos para a Galiléia, para o monte onde Jesus lhes designara.
verses.en_web: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
verses.en_bbe: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had given them orders to go.

verses.en: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
verses.pt: Quando o viram, o adoraram; mas alguns duvidaram.
verses.en_web: When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.
verses.en_bbe: And when they saw him they gave him worship: but some were in doubt.

verses.en: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.pt: E, aproximando-se Jesus, falou-lhes, dizendo: Foi-me dada toda a autoridade no céu e na terra.
verses.en_web: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus came to them and said, All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

verses.en: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verses.pt: Portanto ide, fazei discípulos de todas as nações, batizando-os em nome do Pai, e do Filho, e do Espírito Santo;
verses.en_web: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.en_bbe: Go then, and make disciples of all the nations, giving them baptism in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:

verses.en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.pt: ensinando-os a observar todas as coisas que eu vos tenho mandado; e eis que eu estou convosco todos os dias, até a consumação dos séculos.
verses.en_web: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Teaching them to keep all the rules which I have given you: and see, I am ever with you, even to the end of the world.
